headline: Confusion around XTB. KNF's response is in
summary: XTB shares fell more than 6% from Wednesday's open, extending Tuesday's sell-off triggered by the Polish financial regulator KNF's announced intervention on CFD contracts. The review will be finalised in coming months.
why: XTB is a Warsaw-listed online broker offering CFDs, so regulatory limits on these products directly affect its business model.
why_moved: The Polish financial regulator KNF announced an intervention on CFD contracts, which prompted investors to sell the broker's shares for a second day.
original_headline: Zamieszanie wokół XTB. Jest odpowiedź KNF
